#4129 addition (2026-09-14): added GET /api/portal/customer/timeline/matrix, backing the new Overview Timeline Matrix/List toggle (index.tsx's TimelineCard) — a real per-item-dated feed for Microsoft Changes (publishedAt), Change Windows (scheduledStart/scheduledEnd, #1762) and Policy Reviews (reviewDueAt), plus the same Scans/Findings sources the existing /timeline route already carries. Deliberately a SEPARATE route from GET /api/portal/customer/timeline, not an extension of it: that route's cursor pagination (`before=`, strictly `lt` on the cursor) assumes monotonic backward-only traversal, which breaks the moment a source (a policy review due date, an upcoming change window) is forward-dated rather than past-only — see the route's own header comment. Verified against the real live local testbed data for customer_id=1/msp_id=1 (same tenant as the #4062-#4068 note above) queried directly via DATABASE_URL before writing the apiTests below: 494 real msp_message_center_items rows scoped to this tenant, 74 of them falling inside the default 14-day-back/21-day-fwd window (confirmed via `coalesce(start_date_time, last_modified_date_time) between now()-14d and now()+21d`) — so microsoftChanges is asserted non-empty, a real assertion, not a guess. Zero msp_change_requests rows carry a non-null scheduled_start and zero policy_decisions rows carry a non-null review_due_at for this tenant today, so changeWindows/policyReviews are asserted as real empty arrays (honest-empty, not a fixture). Also added GET /api/portal/offers-backed 'Open Offers' card (useOpenOffers.ts) — that endpoint already has its own coverage in test-manifests/portal/offers-and-sow-acceptance.json, not duplicated here.
